text: The owned endpoint-version patch appends v1.0 at bridge initialization and makes the fake server strip that prefix only when present. The fake server initially continues to accept unversioned paths. Fixed accepted code later rejects requests without the prefix before stripping it, while production version insertion has moved to the client. Preserve those distinct source phases; a prefix test is not a live server conformance or normalization result.
title: The Graph fake server changes from optional to required version prefixes
